newsitem.title: USA: Kmart Corp CEO discounts takeover rumour.
newsitem.headline: Kmart Corp CEO discounts takeover rumour.

text.p: Kmart Corp chairman, president and chief executive officer Floyd Hall said Wednesday that he has not heard from the leveraged buyout firm Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co regarding any takeover offer for the discount retailer and dismissed rumors about a takeover.
Speaking at the opening of the company's second store in Manhattan, Hall told reporters "As far as we know, they are all rumors."
Hall said he had hoped Tuesday's sharp increase in the stock price was due to expectations of the company's third quarter results released on Wednesday.
Kmart's board, however, would be obligated to look at any reasonable offer to acquire the company, Hall said.
"Our board is very tuned to shareholder interests," Hall said.
On Tuesday, Kmart's common shares surged nearly 12 percent to close at 11-1/8, after rumors that Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co would buy the company.
Kmart shares Wednesday traded at 10-1/2, off 5/8, on 6.0 million shares of volume.
